card.name: Inside rare names, KEBILIDI especially
card.fires_on: The last piece of a rare or split-up name, most often the ending "IDI" in the gene therapy name KEBILIDI. It also fires on the closing piece of other unusual proper names and oddly spaced drug names.

modes.label: KEBILIDI ending
modes.description: The ending "IDI" completing the drug name KEBILIDI in its label text.
modes.example: Monitor patients for procedural complications for neurosurgery, including events of respiratory and cardiac arrest after administration of KEBIL<<IDI>>.

modes.label: Other rare names
modes.description: The final piece of an unusual person, place or drug name that is split into several parts.
modes.example: the ECCC charged Kaing Guek E<<av>>, alias Duch, with crimes against humanity
